picks.editorial_note: OpenAI reports its AI system produced an analytic proof addressing part of the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem using thousands of autonomous agents over 88 hours — a landmark test of AI's ability to contribute to unsolved frontier mathematics.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5 million NIA grant extends UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham's joint AI center for aging and Alzheimer's care for five more years, sustaining one of the largest federally-backed AI-health research programs in the country.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: UVM posted a record $222.6 million in research funding, including a $38 million contract — the largest research award in the university's history — signaling major institutional growth in AI-adjacent research capacity.
picks.title: UVM Board of Trustees’ Fall Meeting Highlights Research…

picks.editorial_note: A multi-institution team from MIT, CMU, NYU, and Stanford built an AI system that defeated top human players at Stratego, a landmark result for imperfect-information game AI with implications for negotiation and strategic reasoning research.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: A Harvard Kennedy School Belfer Center report warns that catastrophic AI risks are still preventable but urgent, citing real incidents like rogue-agent breaches and OpenAI's training pause — a high-profile policy intervention shaping the AI safety debate.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: American University in Cairo researchers developed an AI-enabled biochip offering rapid, low-cost disease pre-screening for cancers and other conditions, a notable real-world diagnostic application from a less-represented research region.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $2.2 million Impact Challenge award funds ANU's AI-driven Cytotoxic Resistance Atlas to decode chemotherapy resistance, an industry-academia partnership directly targeting a major unsolved problem in cancer treatment.
picks.title: AI for science: Google.org funding to support ANU-led chemotherapy resistance cancer research

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL, with Google and Northeastern, built 'InstructMesh,' letting users repair and edit AI-generated 3D models before fabrication — closing a key usability gap for generative design in manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab scientists built a machine learning tool that estimates past radiation exposure from routine blood tests, offering a faster alternative to specialized diagnostics with clear implications for emergency medicine and nuclear safety.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: SDSU launched binational shipbuilding research projects with Samsung Heavy Industries and South Korea's KEIT, a notable academia-industry-government partnership applying AI to maritime manufacturing and workforce training.
picks.title: SDSU launches shipbuilding research projects with South Korea, Samsung Heavy Industries | News | SDSU
